# Oscar Introduces a New Wave of Consumer Health Products


October 20, 2026 6:01am EDT


NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[Oscar Insurance](http://hioscar.com/) , one of the fastest-growing insurers in the individual market and part of[Oscar Health](http://www.oscarhealth.com/) , Inc. (NYSE: OSCR), today unveiled its 2027 health insurance lineup for millions of consumers during the open enrollment period. Oscar is entering South Carolina and expanding its footprint to 713 counties across 21 states, a 24% increase in counties from last year.1


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261020140529/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261020140529/en/)


Oscar Insurance, one of the fastest-growing insurers in the individual market and part of Oscar Health, Inc. unveiled its 2027 health insurance lineup for millions of consumers during the open enrollment period.


“The individual market is built for everyone from entrepreneurs launching businesses to people working part-time to employees and gig workers of companies large and small,” said Mark Bertolini, CEO of Oscar Health. “We listen to what they want, what makes their day-to-day easier, and deliver healthcare with intuitive technology that fits their lifestyle. Every Oscar product helps people take control of their health at every stage of life. It's healthcare made-for-me."


**More healthcare choices with clear costs**


Oscar is introducing[RetireEase](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/retire-ease) , a health plan that simplifies the transition from early retirement to Medicare. Members can stay with trusted doctors and receive set prices for preventive visits, lab work, physical therapy, heart care, and bone-and-joint care. The plan also includes $0 generic medications and caregiving, transportation, and Medicare-transition resources. *RetireEase* is available in Arizona, Florida, Ohio, South Carolina, and Texas.


*RetireEase* joins Oscar’s growing product portfolio tailored to life stage, clinical, cultural, and work needs that deliver 15 to 25% in savings.2 Oscar is expanding[HelloMeno](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/hellomeno) to 15 states, offering women navigating menopause a $0 package of hormone replacement therapy, bone-density scans, insomnia medications, and cancer screenings3.[Hy-Vee Health with Oscar](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-hy-vee) is also expanding in Iowa and into Nebraska, Missouri and Kansas, delivering concierge care and healthy food discounts at Hy-Vee stores. Other personalized options include[Diabetes Care](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/diabetes-care) ,[Breathe Easy](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/asthma-copd) ,[Buena Salud](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/buena-salud) , and[Chronic Care](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/chronic-care) .


**Affordable bundles with added financial protection**


Consumers in Florida and Texas can add supplemental cash-pay options to any Oscar plan through a new partnership with[Allstate Health Solutions](https://www.hioscar.com/for-members/supplemental-plans) . These low-cost options help cover medical bills from accidents, serious illnesses, or hospital stays.


Oscar is also introducing more than 250 new Oscar plans with[dental and vision coverage](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-vision-dental) automatically bundled. The all-in-one package includes $0 preventive dental checkups, $0 eye exams, and discounted vision benefits.


**CHOICE gives employees more options**


Employees whose employers offer[CHOICE Arrangements](https://www.hioscar.com/for-employers) can select from more than 250 Oscar products across 15 states. CHOICE is easy: employers contribute a set amount, and employees choose their own health plan that fits their needs – instead of joining one employer-selected plan.


**More rewards in every Oscar membership**


Oscar members have access to[Oswell](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/meet-oswell) , an everyday AI health guide that turns complex questions into personalized guidance, helps members understand and find care, and clarifies next steps. Members can also earn up to $125 in annual rewards points for healthy actions through[Oscar Unlocks](https://www.hioscar.com/get-coverage/oscar-unlocks) .4 Members are eligible to receive an Oscar savings card to use points on premiums and receive up to 60% off at more than 70,000 retailers, gyms, and more.


**Individuals, families, and employees with employer-funded coverage through CHOICE can enroll starting Nov. 1, 2026. How to get started:**


- Consumers: Visit[Healthcare.gov](http://healthcare.gov/) , Oscar’s[Get Coverage page](http://hioscar.com/get-coverage) , call 1-855-672-2788 or an insurance agent.
- Employers with fewer than 50 employees: Get a[free quote](https://www.hioscar.com/for-employers/choice-quote) today.
- Employers with 50+ employees: Visit[CHOICE for employers](http://hioscar.com/for-employers/choice-employers) or speak with a broker.
- IFP brokers: Visit[Oscar for Brokers](http://hioscar.com/for-brokers) to connect clients to an Oscar plan.
- Group brokers: Visit[CHOICE for Brokers](http://hioscar.com/for-employers/choice-brokers) to learn more about CHOICE.


**About Oscar Insurance**


Oscar Insurance is one of the largest and fastest-growing health insurers dedicated to the individual market. Oscar serves millions of individuals across the country with innovative products and CHOICE Arrangement solutions (formerly ICHRA) tailored to their life stages, health needs, and budgets. Oscar’s technology-powered experiences make high-quality care easy to use and feel personal. Oscar is part of Oscar Health, Inc. (NYSE: OSCR). Learn more at[HiOscar.com](http://hioscar.com/) .
